title: payout.paid payload v1
description: A Stripe payout that left the Stripe balance for the bank. With failed: true it is the reversal of one that then failed: the same payout id and amount, the money back in the Stripe balance, under its own idem (stripe:<payout id>:failed).

failed.description: Present and true only on the reversal of a payout that failed after it was paid out.
